h: NFL and players' union reportedly review Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis
p: The NFL and the NFL Players Association are reportedly jointly investigating the medical care given to Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts after a blood clot diagnosis.
more: The review is said to focus on how the condition was identified and treated.
There is no official word yet on when he could return to play.
